BARCHA JAVOBLAR (hammasi matndan TASDIQLANGAN):
  a  It is SHAKESPEARE'S birthplace.
  b  Have lunch at one of the many restaurants in
     SHEEP Street.
  c  Stratford is a SMALL town.


DIQQAT — AUDIO KERAK EMAS:
  Uchala javob ham shu betdagi maqolada
  SO'ZMA-SO'Z bosilgan:
     'is SHAKESPEARE'S birthplace'
     'restaurants in SHEEP STREET'
     'Stratford is a SMALL TOWN'
  Kitob 'listen' desa ham, matnni o'qish yetarli.


ALDAMChI VARIANTLAR NEGA QO'YILGAN:
  'Duke's'      — matnda 'The DUKES Hotel' bor,
                   lekin bu MEHMONXONA nomi,
                   tug'ilgan joy emas.
  'High Street' — matnda 'Stratford HIGH STREET's
                   excellent shops' bor, lekin u
                   DO'KONLAR ko'chasi; restoranlar
                   Sheep Street da.
  'big'         — matn aniq aytadi: 'Stratford is a
                   SMALL town'.

  Ya'ni har bir noto'g'ri variant ham matnda
  UChRAYDI, lekin BOShQA ma'noda — shuning uchun
  diqqat bilan o'qish kerak.


STRATFORD-UPON-AVON HAQIDA:
  Angliyaning janubi-g'arbida, Eyvon daryosi bo'yida.
  Uilyam Shekspir (1564-1616) shu yerda tug'ilgan.
  82-betda ham shu shahar LA bilan solishtirilgan
  edi ('a quiet town in England').
  Rasmda: daryo ustidagi ko'p ravoqli tosh ko'prik.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI
(kichik sarlavhalar to'ldirilgan holda):

  STRATFORD-UPON-AVON

  This romantic town is in the south-west of England
  and is Shakespeare's birthplace.

  A) ACCOMMODATION
  The Dukes Hotel and The Swans Nest are two lovely
  places to stay in Stratford. The Dukes Hotel is a
  three-star hotel in the centre of the town, and
  The Swans Nest is next to the River Avon. They are
  both quiet and friendly places.

  B) PLACES TO VISIT
  For sightseeing, get on an open-topped double-decker
  bus and see the town. You can also visit New Place —
  Shakespeare's home, or go for a walk in the beautiful
  Bancroft Gardens and see the open-air entertainers.
  Another fascinating place to visit is Warwick Castle,
  one of the oldest castles in Britain.

  C) EATING OUT
  There are some fantastic restaurants in Stratford,
  too. Have lunch at one of the many restaurants in
  Sheep Street — the food is delicious — or have a
  romantic dinner at the restaurant on a canal boat
  in the Canal Basin.

  D) SHOPPING
  Buy yourself something nice in one of Stratford High
  Street's excellent shops. However, for gifts, the
  street market in Rother Street is the best.

  E) NIGHTLIFE
  Stratford is a small town. There aren't many
  nightclubs, but you can spend an evening at the
  Royal Shakespeare Theatre or enjoy a quiet drink at
  one of the town's friendly pubs. You can also go for
  a walk along the riverside and enjoy the
  peacefulness of the place under the moon and stars.

  Stratford is the ideal place for an interesting
  holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  STRATFORD-UPON-AVON

  Bu romantik shaharcha Angliyaning janubi-g'arbida
  joylashgan va Shekspirning tug'ilgan joyi.

  A) TURAR JOY
  'Dukes Hotel' va 'Swans Nest' — Stratfordda
  turish uchun ikki ajoyib joy. 'Dukes Hotel' —
  shahar markazidagi uch yulduzli mehmonxona,
  'Swans Nest' esa Eyvon daryosi yonida.
  Ikkalasi ham tinch va samimiy joylar.

  B) BORISh KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR
  Shaharni tomosha qilish uchun ochiq ustli
  ikki qavatli avtobusga chiqing va shaharni
  ko'ring. Shuningdek 'New Place' — Shekspirning
  uyiga borishingiz, yoki go'zal Benkroft bog'ida
  sayr qilib, ochiq havodagi artistlarni
  ko'rishingiz mumkin. Yana bir maftunkor joy —
  Britaniyadagi eng eski qal'alardan biri
  Uorvik qal'asi.

  C) TAShQARIDA OVQATLANISh
  Stratfordda ajoyib restoranlar ham bor.
  Sheep ko'chasidagi ko'plab restoranlarning
  birida tushlik qiling — ovqati mazali — yoki
  Kanal havzasidagi kanal qayig'idagi restoranda
  romantik kechki ovqat qiling.

  D) XARID QILISh
  Stratford High Street dagi a'lo do'konlarning
  birida o'zingizga biror yaxshi narsa sotib oling.
  Lekin sovg'alar uchun Rother ko'chasidagi
  ko'cha bozori eng yaxshisi.

  E) TUNGI HAYOT
  Stratford — kichik shaharcha. Tungi klublar ko'p
  emas, lekin kechqurunni Qirollik Shekspir
  teatrida o'tkazishingiz yoki shaharning samimiy
  pablaridan birida tinchgina ichimlik ichishingiz
  mumkin. Shuningdek daryo bo'yida sayr qilib,
  oy va yulduzlar ostida joyning osoyishtaligidan
  zavqlanishingiz mumkin.

  Stratford — qiziqarli ta'til uchun ideal joy.
  Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang.


DIQQAT — 83-BETDAGI LA MAQOLASI BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  Ikkala maqola ham BIR XIL tuzilishga ega:
     nomi + joylashuvi + qisqa tasvir
     → turar joy
     → ko'riladigan joylar
     → ovqatlanish
     → xarid
     → tungi hayot
     → umumiy taassurot
  Bu — Writing qutisida tushuntirilgan qolip.


DIQQAT — ZAMON:
  Butun maqola HOZIRGI zamonda ('is', 'are',
  'you can'). Joy tasviri DOIMIY holatni
  bildiradi — Writing qutisi ham shuni aytadi:
  'We normally use PRESENT TENSES in this type
   of writing.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a birthplace     = tug'ilgan joy
  sightseeing      = shahar tomosha qilish
  open-topped      = ochiq ustli
  a double-decker  = ikki qavatli avtobus
  open-air         = ochiq havodagi
  an entertainer   = artist, ko'ngil ochuvchi
  a castle         = qal'a ('t' O'QILMAYDI)
  a canal          = kanal
  a basin          = havza
  a gift           = sovg'a
  a street market  = ko'cha bozori
  a nightclub      = tungi klub
  a pub            = pab (ingliz ichimlik joyi)
  the riverside    = daryo bo'yi
  peacefulness     = osoyishtalik
  ideal            = ideal, eng mos
  Don't miss ...   = ... ni boy bermang

Writing qutisidagi qoidaning aynan o'zi.

points.en: A) ACCOMMODATION — The Dukes Hotel and The Swans Nest are two lovely places to stay in Stratford.

'three-star' — sifat sifatida 'star' KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI.

points.en: B) PLACES TO VISIT — For sightseeing, get on an open-topped double-decker bus and see the town.

ORTTIRMA daraja: 'one of THE OLDEST castles'.
'one of the ...' dan keyin KO'PLIK ot.

points.en: C) EATING OUT — There are some fantastic restaurants in Stratford, too.
points.uz: C) TASHQARIDA OVQATLANISH — Stratfordda ajoyib restoranlar ham bor.

'too' bu yerda 'ham' ma'nosida (gap oxirida),

points.en: Have lunch at one of the many restaurants in Sheep Street — the food is delicious — or have a romantic dinner at the restaurant on a canal boat in the Canal Basin.

19a-mashqning b-bandi shu gapdan.

'eat AT a restaurant' (84-bet, 6-mashq).

points.en: D) SHOPPING — Buy yourself something nice in one of Stratford High Street's excellent shops.
points.uz: D) XARID QILISH — Stratford High Street dagi a'lo do'konlarning birida o'zingizga biror yaxshi narsa sotib oling.
points.noteUz:
'buy YOURSELF something' — o'zlik olmoshi.

points.uz: Lekin sovg'alar uchun Rother ko'chasidagi ko'cha bozori eng yaxshisi.

ORTTIRMA: 'THE BEST' — 'good' ning noto'g'ri
orttirma shakli (84-bet jadvalidan).

points.en: E) NIGHTLIFE — Stratford is a small town. There aren't many nightclubs, but you can spend an evening at the Royal Shakespeare Theatre or enjoy a quiet drink at one of the town's friendly pubs.
points.uz: E) TUNGI HAYOT — Stratford kichik shaharcha. Tungi klublar ko'p emas, lekin kechqurunni Qirollik Shekspir teatrida o'tkazishingiz yoki shaharning samimiy pablaridan birida tinchgina ichimlik ichishingiz mumkin.
points.noteUz:
19a-mashqning c-bandi shu gapdan.
'aren't MANY' — sanaladigan ot bilan 'many'.
'a pub' — Britaniyaga xos ichimlik va suhbat joyi.

points.en: You can also go for a walk along the riverside and enjoy the peacefulness of the place under the moon and stars.
points.uz: Shuningdek daryo bo'yida sayr qilib, oy va yulduzlar ostida joyning osoyishtaligidan zavqlanishingiz mumkin.

'along' = bo'ylab (45-betdagi harakat predloglaridan).

points.en: Stratford is the ideal place for an interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it.
points.uz: Stratford — qiziqarli ta'til uchun ideal joy. Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang.

BESh BO'ShLIQ (A, B, C, D, E) va BESh SARLAVHA.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  A  →  ACCOMMODATION   (turar joy)
  B  →  PLACES TO VISIT (borish kerak bo'lgan joylar)
  C  →  EATING OUT      (tashqarida ovqatlanish)
  D  →  SHOPPING        (xarid qilish)
  E  →  NIGHTLIFE       (tungi hayot)


QANDAY ANIQLANDI — HAR BO'LIMNING KALIT SO'ZLARI:

  A: 'The Dukes HOTEL', 'The Swans Nest', 'places TO
     STAY', 'three-star hotel'
     → mehmonxonalar → ACCOMMODATION

  B: 'For SIGHTSEEING', 'see the town', 'VISIT New
     Place', 'go for a walk in the Gardens',
     'Warwick CASTLE'
     → ko'riladigan joylar → PLACES TO VISIT

  C: 'RESTAURANTS', 'have LUNCH', 'the FOOD is
     delicious', 'romantic DINNER'
     → ovqatlanish → EATING OUT

  D: 'BUY yourself something', 'excellent SHOPS',
     'for GIFTS', 'the street MARKET'
     → xarid → SHOPPING

  E: 'NIGHTCLUBS', 'spend an EVENING', 'the Theatre',
     'friendly PUBS', 'under the moon and stars'
     → kechqurungi mashg'ulotlar → NIGHTLIFE


DIQQAT — 83-BETDAGI 4c-MAShQ BILAN BOG'LIQ:
  O'sha mashqda LA maqolasining sarlavhalarini
  ALMAShTIRGAN edingiz:
     ACCOMMODATION → Hotels
     PLACES TO VISIT → Sights
     EATING OUT → Restaurants
     SHOPPING → Shops
     ENTERTAINMENT → Nightlife

  Bu yerda esa AYNAN o'sha sarlavhalar
  QAYTA ishlatilmoqda — kitob ataylab
  bir xil tuzilishni ikki marta ko'rsatmoqda.
  Bu — Writing topshirig'iga tayyorgarlik.

QAYD OLISh — TO'LIQ GAPLARNI EMAS,
faqat KALIT SO'ZLARNI yozish.

TAYYOR QAYDLAR:

  NAME & LOCATION
     Stratford-upon-Avon
     south-west England, on the River Avon
     Shakespeare's birthplace, romantic town

  ACCOMMODATION
     The Dukes Hotel — 3-star, town centre
     The Swans Nest — next to the River Avon
     both quiet + friendly

  PLACES TO VISIT
     open-topped double-decker bus — see the town
     New Place — Shakespeare's home
     Bancroft Gardens — open-air entertainers
     Warwick Castle — one of the oldest in Britain

  EATING OUT
     Sheep Street — many restaurants, delicious food
     Canal Basin — romantic dinner on a canal boat

  SHOPPING
     Stratford High Street — excellent shops
     Rother Street — street market, best for gifts

  NIGHTLIFE
     not many nightclubs
     Royal Shakespeare Theatre
     friendly pubs — quiet drink
     walk along the riverside

  OVERALL IMPRESSION
     ideal place for an interesting holiday
     Don't miss the chance to visit it!


QAYDLARDAN GAPIRISh — NAMUNA:

  'Stratford-upon-Avon is a romantic town in the
   south-west of England. It is Shakespeare's
   birthplace.
   You can stay at The Dukes Hotel, a three-star
   hotel in the town centre, or at The Swans Nest,
   next to the River Avon. Both are quiet and
   friendly.
   For sightseeing, you can take an open-topped
   double-decker bus. You can also visit New Place,
   Shakespeare's home, or Warwick Castle, one of the
   oldest castles in Britain.
   You can have lunch in Sheep Street or a romantic
   dinner on a canal boat.
   For shopping, go to Stratford High Street, but
   for gifts the street market in Rother Street is
   the best.
   There aren't many nightclubs, but you can go to
   the Royal Shakespeare Theatre or to a friendly pub.
   Stratford is the ideal place for an interesting
   holiday!'

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TOVUSh — JUDA O'XShASh, LEKIN FARQI BOR:

  /tf/  —  JARANGSIZ (ovoz paychalari titramaydi)
           o'zbekchadagi 'Ch' tovushi
           misol: CHOY, CHIROQ
           yozilishi: ch- (chin, chair, cheese)

  /dz/  —  JARANGLI (ovoz paychalari titraydi)
           o'zbekchadagi 'J' tovushi (jurnal dagi J)
           misol: JON, JAHON
           yozilishi: j- (Jane, Jerry, jam)
                      yumshoq g- (gin, gym, giant)


QANDAY TEKShIRISh:
  Bo'g'zingizga qo'lingizni qo'ying va ayting:
     'ch' — titrash YO'Q  → /tf/
     'j'  — TITRAYDI      → /dz/


KITOBDAGI OLTI SO'Z:

  CHIN    /tfin/     →  /tf/     (iyak)
  GIN     /dzin/     →  /dz/     (jin — ichimlik)
  JANE    /dzein/    →  /dz/     (Jeyn — ism)
  CHAIN   /tfein/    →  /tf/     (zanjir)
  CHERRY  /tferi/    →  /tf/     (gilos)
  JERRY   /dzeri/    →  /dz/     (Jerri — ism)


DIQQAT — UCh MINIMAL JUFTLIK:
  Kitob so'zlarni ataylab JUFT qilib bergan —
  faqat BITTA tovush bilan farq qiladi:

     CHIN   /tfin/    ↔  GIN    /dzin/
     CHAIN  /tfein/   ↔  JANE   /dzein/
     CHERRY /tferi/   ↔  JERRY  /dzeri/

  Har juftlikda qolgan tovushlar BIR XIL —
  faqat birinchi tovush farq qiladi.
  Bunday juftliklar 'minimal pairs' deyiladi va
  talaffuzni mashq qilish uchun eng foydali usul.


DIQQAT — 'GIN' ALDAMChI:
  'g' harfi bilan yozilsa ham, /dz/ deb o'qiladi.
  QOIDA: 'g' dan keyin e, i yoki y kelsa —
  odatda /dz/ deb o'qiladi:
     GIN, GYM, GIANT, GENTLE, PAGE, AGE
  Boshqa hollarda /g/:
     GO, GARDEN, GUN, BAG
  ISTISNOLAR: GET, GIVE, GIRL — /g/ bilan.


O'ZBEK O'QUVChILARI UChUN:
  Bu ikki tovush o'zbek tilida ham bor ('ch' va 'j'),
  shuning uchun ularni aytish QIYIN EMAS.
  Asosiy qiyinchilik — YOZILIShIDAN tovushni
  to'g'ri aniqlash ('gin' kabi so'zlarda).

items.whyUz:
/tf/ — JARANGSIZ.
'ch-' bilan yoziladi → deyarli doim /tf/.
O'zbekcha 'Ch' tovushi (CHOY dagidek).
JUFTI: 'gin' /dzin/.

/dz/ — JARANGLI.
DIQQAT — ALDAMChI: 'g' harfi bilan yozilgan,
lekin /dz/ deb o'qiladi.
QOIDA: 'g' dan keyin e, i, y kelsa → /dz/
(gin, gym, giant, page, age).
JUFTI: 'chin' /tfin/.

/dz/ — JARANGLI.
'J-' bilan yoziladi → doim /dz/.
O'zbekcha 'J' tovushi (JON dagidek).
JUFTI: 'chain' /tfein/.

/tf/ — JARANGSIZ.
'ch-' bilan yoziladi → /tf/.
JUFTI: 'Jane' /dzein/ —
faqat BIRINCHI tovush farq qiladi.

/dz/ — JARANGLI.
'J-' bilan yoziladi → /dz/.
JUFTI: 'cherry' /tferi/ —
faqat BIRINCHI tovush farq qiladi.

sections.title: Writing — a description of a place

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article for a magazine describing a place ...
exercises.instructionUz: Jurnal uchun joyni tasvirlovchi maqola yozganimizda ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — JOY TASVIRLAB MAQOLA YOZISh:

  1) Jurnal uchun joyni tasvirlovchi maqola
     yozganda ma'lumotni MOS KIChIK SARLAVHALAR
     ostida berish mumkin.

  2) BOShLAYMIZ:
        joyning NOMI + JOYLAShUVI
        keyin QISQA umumiy TASVIR

  3) SHUNDAN KEYIN gaplashamiz:
        sayyohlar qayerda TURIShI mumkin
           (accommodation)
        BORIB KO'RISh yoki OVQATLANISh mumkin
           bo'lgan joylar
        qayerda XARID qilish mumkin
        TUNGI HAYOT

  4) TUGATAMIZ:
        joy haqidagi UMUMIY TAASSUROT

  5) SIFATLAR tasvirni QIZIQARLIROQ qiladi.

  6) Bunday yozuvda odatda HOZIRGI zamon
     ishlatiladi.


SXEMA — MAQOLANING TUZILIShI:

   ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
   │  NOMI + JOYLAShUVI + qisqa tasvir    │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  ACCOMMODATION   (turar joy)         │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  PLACES TO VISIT (ko'riladigan joy)  │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  EATING OUT      (ovqatlanish)       │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  SHOPPING        (xarid)             │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  NIGHTLIFE       (tungi hayot)       │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  UMUMIY TAASSUROT                    │
   └──────────────────────────────────────┘


BU SXEMA IKKI MARTA KO'RSATILGAN:
  83-bet — Los Angeles maqolasi
  87-bet — Stratford-upon-Avon maqolasi
  Ikkalasi ham AYNAN shu tartibda yozilgan.


DIQQAT — ZAMON:
  'We normally use PRESENT TENSES in this type of
   writing.'
  Sabab: joy tasviri DOIMIY holatni bildiradi
  ('The town IS ...', 'You CAN visit ...').
  Hikoyada esa (Unit 11) O'TGAN zamon ishlatilgan edi.

DIQQAT — SIFATLAR ENG MUHIM:
  'Adjectives make our description more interesting.'
  romantic, lovely, quiet, friendly, beautiful,
  fascinating, fantastic, delicious, excellent, ideal
  — Stratford maqolasidagi sifatlar.

points.en: When we write an article for a magazine describing a place, we may give the information under suitable sub-headings.
points.uz: Jurnal uchun joyni tasvirlovchi maqola yozganimizda ma'lumotni mos kichik sarlavhalar ostida berishimiz mumkin.
points.noteUz: 83 va 87-betdagi ikkala maqola ham shunday.

points.en: We start by stating the name of the place and its location, then we give a short general description of the place.
points.uz: Joyning nomi va joylashuvini aytishdan boshlaymiz, so'ng joyning qisqacha umumiy tasvirini beramiz.
points.noteUz:
Stratford: 'This romantic town is in the south-west
of England and is Shakespeare's birthplace.'

points.en: After that, we talk about where visitors can stay (accommodation), places to visit or eat at, where to go shopping and the nightlife.
points.uz: Shundan keyin sayyohlar qayerda turishi (turar joy), borib ko'rish yoki ovqatlanish mumkin bo'lgan joylar, qayerda xarid qilish va tungi hayot haqida gapiramiz.
points.noteUz: BESH kichik sarlavha — 19b-mashqdagi tartib.

points.en: We end by giving an overall impression of the place. Adjectives make our description more interesting.
points.uz: Joy haqidagi umumiy taassurot bilan tugatamiz. Sifatlar tasvirimizni qiziqarliroq qiladi.
points.noteUz:
Stratford: 'Stratford is the ideal place for an
interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to
visit it.'

points.en: We normally use present tenses in this type of writing.
points.uz: Bunday yozuvda odatda hozirgi zamondan foydalanamiz.
points.noteUz:
Joy tasviri DOIMIY holat →
hozirgi zamon ('is', 'are', 'you can').
Unit 11 dagi hikoyada esa O'TGAN zamon edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the information in the Photo File section, then write an article about Antwerp. Give the information under suitable sub-headings (120 - 150 words).
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi ma'lumotga qarang, so'ng Antverpen haqida maqola yozing. Ma'lumotni mos kichik sarlavhalar ostida bering (120-150 so'z).
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh:
  Bu topshiriq kitobning OXIRIDAGI 'Photo File'
  bo'limidagi Antverpen haqidagi ma'lumotga
  tayanadi. Bizdagi skanda o'sha bo'lim YO'Q.

  Shuning uchun quyida:
    • maqolaning TUZILIShI va QOLIPLARI
      (bular kitobdan — 100% aniq)
    • Antverpen haqidagi UMUMIY ma'lumotga
      asoslangan NAMUNA
      (kitobning Photo File dagi aniq mehmonxona,
       restoran va do'kon nomlari BOShQAChA
       bo'lishi mumkin)

  Kitobingizning orqa qismidagi Photo File
  bo'limini ochib, o'sha yerdagi ANIQ nomlarni
  quyidagi qoliplarga qo'ying.


ANTVERPEN HAQIDA (umumiy ma'lumot):
  Antwerp (golland tilida Antwerpen) —
  Belgiyaning ikkinchi eng katta shahri,
  Shelda (Scheldt) daryosi bo'yida.
  Dunyodagi eng yirik OLMOS savdosi markazi.
  Rassom Piter Paul Rubens shu yerda yashagan.
  Grote Markt (Bosh maydon) va Bizanti uslubidagi
  Onamiz sobori (Cathedral of Our Lady) mashhur.
  Shuningdek moda va dizayn markazi.


TO'LIQ NAMUNA MAQOLA (138 so'z):

  ANTWERP

  This beautiful city is in the north of Belgium,
  on the River Scheldt. It is famous for its
  diamonds and its fashion.

  ACCOMMODATION
  There are many comfortable hotels near the main
  square. The hotels in the centre are more
  expensive than those near the station, but they
  are quiet and friendly.

  PLACES TO VISIT
  Don't miss the Cathedral of Our Lady, one of the
  most beautiful churches in Europe. You can also
  visit the Rubens House and walk around the Grote
  Markt, the old main square.

  EATING OUT
  There are some excellent restaurants near the
  river. Try the Belgian chocolate — it is
  delicious!

  SHOPPING
  For designer clothes, go to the Meir. For
  diamonds, the shops near the station are the best.

  NIGHTLIFE
  The nightlife is exciting. There are lots of
  friendly cafes and clubs in the old town.

  Antwerp is the ideal place for a short holiday.
  Don't miss the chance to visit it!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  ANTVERPEN

  Bu go'zal shahar Belgiyaning shimolida, Shelda
  daryosi bo'yida joylashgan. U olmoslari va
  modasi bilan mashhur.

  TURAR JOY
  Bosh maydon yaqinida ko'plab qulay mehmonxonalar
  bor. Markazdagi mehmonxonalar vokzal yonidagilardan
  qimmatroq, lekin ular tinch va samimiy.

  BORISh KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR
  Yevropadagi eng go'zal cherkovlardan biri —
  Onamiz soborini boy bermang. Shuningdek Rubens
  uyiga borib, eski bosh maydon Grote Markt
  bo'ylab sayr qilishingiz mumkin.

  TAShQARIDA OVQATLANISh
  Daryo yaqinida a'lo restoranlar bor. Belgiya
  shokoladini tatib ko'ring — u mazali!

  XARID QILISh
  Dizayner kiyimlar uchun Meir ko'chasiga boring.
  Olmoslar uchun esa vokzal yonidagi do'konlar
  eng yaxshisi.

  TUNGI HAYOT
  Tungi hayot juda qiziqarli. Eski shaharda
  ko'plab samimiy kafe va klublar bor.

  Antverpen — qisqa ta'til uchun ideal joy.
  Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang!


SO'Z SONI: 138 — kitob so'ragan 120-150 oralig'ida.


QANDAY QILIB O'ZINGIZNIKINI YOZASIZ:
  1) Photo File dagi ANIQ nomlarni yozib oling
  2) Har birini mos sarlavha ostiga qo'ying
  3) Quyidagi qoliplardan foydalaning
  4) Kamida 6-8 ta SIFAT ishlating
  5) HOZIRGI zamonda yozing
  6) 'Don't miss the chance to visit it!' bilan
     tugating

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh MAQOL — HAMMASI 'YO'QLIK' VA 'SAYOHAT'
HAQIDA.


1)  SEE NEW PLACES, MEET NEW FACES.
    = Yangi joylarni ko'r, yangi odamlarni uchrat.

    Bu — UNIT 12 NING NOMI.
    Ma'nosi: sayohat qilish odamni boyitadi —
    yangi joylar yangi tanishlar, yangi tajriba
    va yangi fikrlar olib keladi.

    'faces' (yuzlar) = 'people' (odamlar).
    'places' va 'faces' QOFIYALANADI.

    O'ZBEKChA MAQOL: 'Ko'p yurgan ko'p biladi.'


2)  ABSENCE MAKES THE HEART GROW FONDER.
    = Ayriliq qalbni mehribonroq qiladi.

    So'zma-so'z: 'Yo'qlik yurakni ko'proq
    sevadigan qiladi.'

    Ma'nosi: kimnidir uzoq vaqt ko'rmasangiz,
    uni YANADA KO'PROQ sog'inasiz va qadrini
    bilasiz.

    'absence' = yo'qlik, uzoqda bo'lish
    'fond of sb' = kimnidir yaxshi ko'radigan
    'fonder' = 'fond' ning QIYOSIY darajasi
               (Unit 12 ning grammatikasi!)
    'make sb/sth + sifat' = ... ni ... qilmoq

    O'ZBEKChA MAQOL: 'Ayriliq muhabbatni
    kuchaytiradi.'


3)  OUT OF SIGHT, OUT OF MIND.
    = Ko'zdan yiroq — ko'ngildan yiroq.

    So'zma-so'z: 'Ko'rinishdan tashqarida —
    xayoldan tashqarida.'

    Ma'nosi: kimnidir ko'rmasangiz, asta-sekin
    UNUTASIZ.

    'out of sight' = ko'rinmaydigan joyda
    'out of mind'  = xayoldan chiqib ketgan
    'sight' — 83-betda 'diqqatga sazovor joy'
              ma'nosida edi; bu yerda 'ko'rish'.

    O'ZBEKChA MAQOL: 'Ko'zdan yiroq —
    ko'ngildan yiroq.'


ENG QIZIQ NUQTA — 2 VA 3-MAQOL QARAMA-QARShI!

  2-maqol:  ko'rmasang — KO'PROQ sevasan
  3-maqol:  ko'rmasang — UNUTASAN

  Ikkalasi ham ingliz tilida keng ishlatiladi,
  lekin BUTUNLAY TESKARI narsani aytadi.

  Bu — maqollarning tabiati: ular umumiy
  HAYOTIY HAQIQATNI emas, MA'LUM BIR HOLATNI
  ifodalaydi. Qaysi biri to'g'ri ekani
  vaziyatga bog'liq.

  Xuddi o'zbekchadagi kabi:
     'Yetti o'lchab bir kes' ↔ 'Tez qilgan ishning
      tezi chiqadi'


DIQQAT — 'FONDER' GRAMMATIKASI:
  'fond' (mehribon, yaxshi ko'radigan) —
  BIR BO'G'INLI sifat → 'fondER'.
  Bu — 84-betdagi qoidaning amaliy misoli.

items.derivedUz: gin, gym, giant, gentle, page, age

groups.explanationUz: Faqat BITTA tovush bilan farq qiladi.
Chiziqcha bilan yoziladi, birinchi qism KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI.

patterns.formula: This [sifat] town/city is in the [tomon] of [mamlakat] and is [nima bilan mashhur].
patterns.exampleEn: This romantic town is in the south-west of England and is Shakespeare's birthplace.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu romantik shaharcha Angliyaning janubi-g'arbida joylashgan va Shekspirning tug'ilgan joyi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Maqolaning BIRINCHI gapi:
nomi/turi + JOYLASHUVI + qisqa tasvir.
Writing qutisidagi qoida.

patterns.formula: X and Y are two lovely places TO STAY in [shahar].
patterns.exampleEn: The Dukes Hotel and The Swans Nest are two lovely places to stay in Stratford.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Dukes Hotel' va 'Swans Nest' Stratfordda turish uchun ikki ajoyib joy.
patterns.explanationUz:
ACCOMMODATION bo'limining ochilish qolipi.
'a place TO STAY / TO VISIT / TO EAT AT'.

patterns.formula: Another fascinating place to visit is X, ONE OF THE [orttirma] [ko'plik ot] in [joy].
patterns.exampleEn: Another fascinating place to visit is Warwick Castle, one of the oldest castles in Britain.
patterns.exampleUz: Yana bir maftunkor joy — Britaniyadagi eng eski qal'alardan biri Uorvik qal'asi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'one of the ...' dan keyin DOIM KO'PLIK ot.
ORTTIRMA daraja 'the' bilan.

patterns.formula: However, for [nima], the [joy] is THE BEST.
patterns.exampleEn: However, for gifts, the street market in Rother Street is the best.
patterns.exampleUz: Lekin sovg'alar uchun Rother ko'chasidagi ko'cha bozori eng yaxshisi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'However' = lekin (rasmiy).
'the best' — 'good' ning noto'g'ri orttirma shakli.

patterns.formula: X is the ideal place for a/an [sifat] holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it.
patterns.exampleEn: Stratford is the ideal place for an interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it.
patterns.exampleUz: Stratford — qiziqarli ta'til uchun ideal joy. Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang.
patterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat maqolasining an'anaviy TUGALLANMASI:
umumiy taassurot + chaqiriq.
